typography.rules: Never center headings by default. Ensure tabular numerals (tabular-nums) for all financial data to prevent layout shift.

color_palette.rules: Color is Function Only. 95% of the UI must be monochrome (shades of deep black/grey/white). Use status colors exclusively to guide action (e.g., green for profit/active agents, red for loss/errors, yellow for slippage/warnings). Never use pure #000000; #0A0A0A is the base. No gradients.

layout_and_spacing.rules: High density. Use 1px solid borders (border-border) and flat backgrounds. Expose the grid structure by removing outer radiuses. Never fill 100% of the grid perfectly if not needed, use empty spaces as visual breaks. No heavy drop shadows; use sharp, thin borders.

surface_strategies.dashboard_cards: Grid Borders style. Flat background (bg-[#111111]), 1px border (border-[#222222]), rounded-none or max rounded-sm (2px/4px).
surface_strategies.headers: Solid deep black (bg-[#0A0A0A]) with a hard 1px bottom border. No glassmorphism.
surface_strategies.buttons_primary: Solid white background, black text. Hover: bg-gray-200.
surface_strategies.buttons_secondary: Transparent background, 1px white border, white text. Hover: bg-white/10.
surface_strategies.ai_terminal: Retro-Futurism 'Terminal' look. Deep black background, 1px border border-[#333333]. Content inside must use monospace font and a subtle 10% white text for logs, highlighted by white primary results.

component_rules.tables: Dense. Use Shadcn Table. Remove all rounded corners. Use monospace fonts (IBM Plex Mono) for all numbers, prices, and hashes. Align numbers to the right.
component_rules.charts: Use Shadcn charts (Recharts). Render simple, thin 1px lines without filled area gradients. Use the exact status colors (e.g., #00FF66 for profit).
component_rules.forms_inputs: Shadcn components, heavily customized: rounded-none, border-[#333333], focus:ring-1 focus:ring-white focus:border-white.
component_rules.status_badges: Minimalist. Instead of full colored pills, use a 6px dot (w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full) beside uppercase monospace text.
component_rules.notifications: Sonner toast notifications. Dark mode forced. Position: bottom-right. Strict square edges, 1px border.
component_rules.payments_stripe: Integrate seamlessly with the dark, high-contrast theme. Dedicated modal or page using pure white accents for checkout CTAs.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Buttons must have explicit hover states (e.g., hover:bg-white hover:text-black for outlined buttons). Table rows should have a very subtle bg-[#151515] on hover.
motion_and_interactions.loading: Use monospace ASCII loaders or simple rapid blinking cursors instead of standard circular spinners.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text meets at least 4.5:1 ratio against #0A0A0A/#111111.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements, table rows, and key metrics MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='agent-status-toggle', data-testid='profit-metric').

icons.style: strokeWidth={1.5}, monochromatic (white or grey) unless indicating status.

abstract_data_bg.description: Abstract, computer-generated squares/rectangles in dark mode. Use as a very subtle, low-opacity (10-20%) background layer for hero sections, empty states, or behind the AI Trading Insights panel.

agent_avatar_placeholder.description: Abstract black and white geometry. Use as a placeholder avatar/icon for individual Swarm Agents.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts: Chivo, IBM Plex Sans, IBM Plex Mono via Google Fonts.
Override default Tailwind rounded configurations to be completely sharp (rounded-none) or extremely subtle (rounded-sm) globally to match the Swiss Brutalist aesthetic.
Implement the layout using CSS Grid heavily. This is a 'Control Room', so use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 or up to 12 columns for precise dashboard widgets.
For the Live Agents Dashboard: Display active agents as individual bento-box cards or a dense data table. Include metrics like win rate, live PnL, and current status.
For the AI Trading Insights (GPT): Design this section like a command-line terminal. Monospace font, dark background, raw data look.
Validation Runs, Exchange Gate Management, and Drift Checks must be presented in dense, monospace-heavy tables. Status must use the 6px colored dot convention.
Add 'data-testid' to every actionable button, tab, and row to support automated testing.
Ensure the UI is responsive, stacking the bento grids elegantly on mobile screens, and utilizing a horizontal scroll or compact list for tables on small screens.
Use strict spacing scale (p-4, p-6). Elements inside containers with borders MUST have padding to avoid edge collision.
